newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch - May 19.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch - May 19.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors affecting Indian stock markets on Monday morning:
** Investors are expected to stay on the sidelines as they await an increase in oil prices by the government
The coalition government's steering committee is set to
meet on May 25 to raise prices of oil, which India imports but sells below world prices through a complex cross subsidy system
** India's annual inflation as measured by the wholesale price index dropped to 5.98 percent in the week ended May 3 from 6.35 percent in the previous week, government figures show
** India hopes industrial activity would pick up boosting imports and help tame rupee's stubborn strength
** Scooter giant Bajaj Auto to announce bonus equity issue on Monday
** Ranbaxy Laboratories promoters seek government permission to sell 3.5 million shares to foreign firm, the Economic Times reports
** Hectic activity likely in tobacco conglomerate ITC Ltd ahead of earnings announcement on Tuesday for fiscal 1996/97 (April-March)
** Truck maker Tata Engineering and Locomotive Company planning $200 million Yankee bond issue in the United States, the Economic Times says
** Bombay's benchmark 30-share index ended 9.70 points lower at 3,759.64 last week.
** The rupee opened steady at 35.795/805 per dollar on Monday, seen gaining on strong supply and poor demand - dealers
